+    """PCHIP interpolation by chord length, with a dense pixel-space trace."""
+    a = np.asarray(points, dtype=float)
+    ds = np.hypot(np.diff(a[:, 0]), np.diff(a[:, 1]))
+    ss = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(ds)]
+    # Remove duplicate vertices before constructing monotone interpolators.
+    keep = np.r_[True, np.diff(ss) > 1e-8]
+    a, ss = a[keep], ss[keep]
+    q = np.arange(0.0, ss[-1], step_px)
+    if len(q) == 0 or q[-1] < ss[-1]:
+        q = np.r_[q, ss[-1]]
+    return np.column_stack([PchipInterpolator(ss, a[:, j])(q) for j in range(3)])

+    distances = np.r_[distances, cum[-1]]
